parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is offering a new 2-day workshop Growth Modeling with SEM in Mplus and R (lavaan), running Oct 24-25 with Stanford University professor Nilam Ram and ASU professor Kevin Grimm. This comprehensive seminar provides essential training for analyzing longitudinal data in various disciplines in the structural equation modeling (SEM) framework. Growth curve modeling is an essential tool for understanding how individuals change over time and why individuals change in different ways. This workshop will cover the basics of linear growth models and progress to more complex nonlinear models, including polynomial, piece-wise, shape-factor, and structured latent curves. By the end of the workshop, participants will have a solid foundation in applying these models. The seminar's hands-on approach ensures that participants will not only learn the theoretical aspects but also gain practical skills in data analysis with linear and nonlinear growth models, enhancing their ability to conduct sophisticated longitudinal research.

Sign up today to secure your spot in this unique seminar to learn about this powerful longitudinal data analysis method.


Best wishes
